fields.name: copy
fields.meaning: The whole save is one block of 0x14de bytes stored six times, at 0x0000 + n*0x14de (n=0..5). Every save writes the same data to all six; when loading, the game uses the first copy whose checksums are right. Rows below use copy 0
fields.evidence: code 4000:76fd (writer loops 6 times, step 0x14de), 4000:79b8/4000:7926/4000:786a (readers pick first good copy); diff natural save: copies 1-5 byte-identical, copy 0 differs only in the stray bytes listed below

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Format mark 0x0114. At power-on any copy without it is wiped to zero and given the mark and a matching header checksum
fields.evidence: code 4000:7828 (boot check+wipe), boot reads at 4000:783c; diff blank vs power-on formatted (0x0000 and 0x0006 set in all six copies)

fields.name: last_book
fields.meaning: Record book (story file) that was open last, 0-2; becomes the cursor position on the book screen at the next power-on
fields.evidence: code 4000:08e1 (saved from the open-book number), 4000:759b (copy in/out, clamped 0-3), 4000:010c (boot load), title book-pick 0-2; natural-save value 0

fields.name: last_chapter
fields.meaning: Chapter that was open last, 0-5; the record book opens on this chapter at the next power-on
fields.evidence: code 4000:08e9 (saved from the current-chapter number), 4000:759b, boot read at 4000:79ea; diff blank vs story-started (0->1); natural-save value 1 and the book opens on chapter 2 (verified screens), blank memory opens on chapter 1

fields.name: header_sum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of the three words 0x0000-0x0005
fields.evidence: code 4000:7795 (compute), 4000:79b8 (check, boot read at 4000:79f1); recomputed natural save 0x0114+0+1=0x0115 in all six copies

fields.name: book
fields.meaning: Three record books (story files) of 0x6f2 bytes at 0x0008 + b*0x6f2 (b=0..2): a 14-byte book header, then six chapter pages of 0x126 bytes. Rows below use book 0
fields.evidence: code 4000:72b3 (offset = book*0x6f2 + chapter*0x126), 4000:76fd (+0x08 header, +0x16 pages)

fields.name: chapter_results
fields.meaning: Five words, one per chapter 1-5: the result value the story script hands over when that chapter ends (nonzero = chapter finished; the value likely says which ending was reached)
fields.evidence: code 4000:1c80 (chapter end: stores the script value for the current chapter, flags a change), 4000:74e8/4000:7504 (copy to/from save); all zero in every save seen

fields.name: all_chapters_done
fields.meaning: Set to 1 when all five chapter results are nonzero (all five chapters finished); unlocks chapter 6 (max chapter becomes 5 instead of 4)
fields.evidence: code 4000:1dfb (checks with 4000:75e9, sets with 4000:7610, then saves the book header), title max-chapter logic; never set in the saves seen

fields.name: book_header_sum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of the six words 0x0008-0x0013
fields.evidence: code 4000:7795, 4000:7926 (check); recomputed over all books and copies of two story saves

fields.name: chapter_page
fields.meaning: Six chapter pages of 0x126 bytes per book at book + 0x0e + c*0x126 (c=0..5 = chapters 1-6; chapter 6 is the final chapter, unlocked after the others). Each page is seven blocks, each block followed by its own checksum word. Rows below use book 0 chapter 1 (0x0016); the natural-save progress sits in book 0 chapter 2 at 0x013c
fields.evidence: code 4000:72b3, 4000:7795 (7 block table at 4000:728f/7297/72a5), 4000:786a (check), 4000:1dfb (chapter 6 unlock); diff story-started save (changes at 0x013c-0x019a = book 0 page 1)

fields.name: times_started
fields.meaning: How many times this chapter was started from the beginning
fields.evidence: code 4000:754a (count 0, +1, wraps 0xffff to 0x100) called from 4000:1425 (new story); diff blank vs story-started: book 0 chapter 2 0x013c 0->1

fields.name: times_finished
fields.meaning: How many times this chapter was played to its end
fields.evidence: code 4000:754a (count 1) called from 4000:1c80 (chapter end), read by the book screen via 4000:756c; zero in all saves seen

fields.name: in_progress
fields.meaning: 1 while a story in this chapter is under way (a bookmark can be resumed), 0 after the chapter ends. Decides whether the book shows a resume or the new-game prompt
fields.evidence: code 4000:7581 (set to 1 at start in 4000:1425, to 0 at end in 4000:1c80), 4000:dc7b (book screen reads it); diff blank vs story-started: 0x0140 0->1; verified save shows no new-game prompt

fields.name: story_mode_a
fields.meaning: Copy of a story-state word (set to 2 when a chapter starts); meaning unknown
fields.evidence: code 4000:738b/4000:73ad via 4000:32de (RAM 0x0a5e); diff blank vs story-started: 0x0142 0->2

fields.name: story_mode_b
fields.meaning: Copy of a second story-state word (0 when a chapter starts); meaning unknown

fields.name: story_mode_c
fields.meaning: Meant to hold a third story-state word (set to 3 at chapter start), but the save routine copies an unrelated scratch word, so it is normally 0
fields.evidence: code 4000:738b reads 0x0c9c while caller 4000:32de puts the value in 0x0c98; 0 in all saves

fields.name: block1_sum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of the six words 0x0016-0x0021
fields.evidence: code 4000:7795/4000:786a; recomputed natural-save book 0 chapter 2: 1+0+1+2+0+0=4 at 0x0148

fields.name: scene_display
fields.meaning: Screen state at the bookmark: background, picture layers and music, restored when the story is resumed
fields.evidence: code 4000:3522 (copy to/from RAM 0x0a2c-0x0a43), 4000:3cab (restore on resume), 4000:3ba1/4000:21f6 (writers); diffs across later story saves (0x014e-0x0157 change as scenes change)

fields.name: scene_number
fields.meaning: Scene number of the bookmark; also picks the entry in the per-scene table at page+0xa4
fields.evidence: code 4000:7520/4000:7535 via 4000:3338 (RAM 0x0a50), 4000:3a62 (resume uses it as table index); 0 in all saves seen

fields.name: story_position
fields.meaning: Position in the story script at the bookmark; goes up as the story moves on
fields.evidence: code 4000:7520/4000:7535 via 4000:3338 (RAM 0x0a54), 4000:3a62 (resume seeks the script to it); diffs across later story saves: 0x0164 = 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

fields.name: block2_sum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of the 14 words 0x0024-0x003f
fields.evidence: code 4000:7795/4000:786a; recomputed (deep story save 0x0166)

fields.name: run_values
fields.meaning: Eight story variables of the current run, cleared when a chapter is started
fields.evidence: code 4000:7478/4000:7494 via 4000:3338 (RAM 0x09f6-0x0a05), cleared in 4000:1425; zero in all saves seen

fields.name: block3_sum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of the eight words 0x0042-0x0051
fields.evidence: code 4000:7795/4000:786a; recomputed

fields.name: story_flags
fields.meaning: 256 story flags (bit n of byte n/8), set and tested by the story script
fields.evidence: code 4000:73ca (set), 4000:73ea (test) via script command 4000:34a0; diff blank vs story-started: 0x017a bit 0 set

fields.name: block4_sum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of the 16 words 0x0054-0x0073
fields.evidence: code 4000:7795/4000:786a; recomputed natural save 0x019a = 1

fields.name: seen_flags
fields.meaning: 256 flags kept across plays: at each chapter end the current-run flags (page+0x82) are added (OR) here; likely records branches or endings already seen
fields.evidence: code 4000:7624 (OR merge, called from chapter end 4000:1c80); zero in all saves seen

fields.name: block5_sum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of the 16 words 0x0076-0x0095

fields.name: run_flags
fields.meaning: 256 flags for the current run, cleared at chapter start and merged into page+0x60 at chapter end
fields.evidence: code 4000:740c (set), 4000:742c (test) via script command 4000:34e0; 4000:7648 (clear, from 4000:1425)

fields.name: block6_sum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of the 16 words 0x0098-0x00b7

fields.name: scene_table
fields.meaning: 128 one-byte values, one per scene number, written and read by the story script
fields.evidence: code 4000:744e (write), 4000:7463 (read) via script command 4000:345c; zero in all saves seen

fields.name: block7_sum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of the 64 words 0x00ba-0x0139

fields.name: stray_sound_bytes
fields.meaning: Not save data. Copy 0 only: 0x0420-0x04bf (silence wave pattern 0x88) and 0x0ba8-0x0bab, 0x0bdc-0x0bdf (sound counters) are written by the sound interrupt handler, which uses the caller's memory segment; when it runs while the save memory is mapped, the bytes land here. They spoil 7 checksums in copy 0, so the game falls back to copy 1
fields.evidence: code 4000:54cb (wave tables and channel states), 4000:0f40/1139 (decrement of 0x0bdc); copy 0 vs copy 1 diffs across all saves; values match (0x88, 3, decrementing counter, 0x0f); zeroing them makes copy 0 fully checksummed

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: After the six copies; always zero
fields.evidence: diff all saves (never nonzero)

values.value: Not used by this game; identical across all saves seen.
